headline: WSN @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 4.32 at ATL 5.39, with a projected total of 9.71. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: WSN moved +0.59 runs while ATL moved -0.11, changing the projected margin by +0.70 runs. The projected total climbed +0.47, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Daylen Lile, Drake Baldwin, CJ Abrams, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nasim Nuñez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
